correctness.rationale: A fully explicit KKT description gives a piecewise-affine projector. On a strict face of k free cells, the zero-sum tangent Jacobian has exact supnorm 1+min(N-k,k-2)/k; the proof gives both sign-configuration maximizers and the all-face maximum. Generic-segment integration supplies a global bound; all interior masses admit a strict-face equality witness. Fraction-based tests exhaust tangent cube vertices for N<=10, test 90 mass-specific exact witnesses, and replay floating-point projected pairs. The proof, not finite checks, covers all dimensions. N=2 is handled by the identity on feasible interior pairs.

value.rationale: The motivating numerical-PDE limiter preserves mass and bounds with proved L2 stability, but does not quantify the maximum-norm response to two equally conservative approximate cell-average vectors. The sharp factor pinpoints the first amplification at four cells and grows toward two, supplying an exact perturbation budget for comparing solver outputs, iterative inaccuracies, or stage-to-stage perturbations. The complete dimension/mass classification and explicit witnesses are more informative than a routine norm equivalence; no claim is made about one-sided error to an admissible exact state or a complete DG PDE timestep.
